stata_syntax_checks.description: Micro syntax begins with a CSES processing header.
Major sections use the CSES section marker style.
Each generated target variable is verified with tab ..., mis.
Missing values are recoded explicitly to CSES codes.
Variable and value labels are applied through label files.
Validation, inconsistency, and theoretical checks are run.
The final do-file runs cleanly in Stata.

documentation_checks.description: Processing log contains all required CSES sections.
Study design and weights claims cite deposited sources.
Eligibility decision records item coverage, sample design, and sample size.
Collaborator questions are focused, grouped, and contextualized.
Pre-release TODOs are empty or explicitly resolved before final deposit.

common_section_order: VOTE CHOICE - IMD NUMERIC PARTY CODE VARIABLES
